scenes.a: Before you answer that difficult email or make this midday decision, turn your heart upward.
Nehemiah 2:4 says, 'The king said to me, What is it you want? Then I prayed to the God of heaven.'
Lord, in the split second before we speak, give us the wisdom to seek Your face.
When pressure demands an immediate response, teach us to whisper a prayer first.
You hear the silent cries of our heart in busy corridors and quiet offices alike.
Grant us clarity, courage, and divine direction right now in the middle of our workday.
Subscribe to The Midday Watch for daily noonday prayer.
